content.text:
## Inventory summary

| Item | Finding |
|---|---|
| **Versions** | Root-Core `1.7.5` · Root-Discord `1.7.14` · JDA `6.4.2` (~11.5 MB jar) |
| **Heartbeat** | `root-discord` is in `heartbeatManifestPluginNames` — **not** retired |
| **Handoffs** | All three hosts have both `root-core-1.7.5.jar` + `root-discord-1.7.14.jar` |
| **Softdepend Root-Discord** | Only `rootmc` + `rootmc-official` |
| **API consumers** | `PublicReachoutService`, `OfficialHourlyLogRelay` via `ShadedServiceBridge.resolveDiscord` |

---

## 1. Root-Discord files (move into Core)

| Source | Target under Core |
|---|---|
| `...\root-discord\src\main\java\...\rootdiscord\DiscordChatBridge.java` | `...\root-core\src\main\java\...\rootcore\comms\DiscordChatBridge.java` |
| `...\DiscordChatConfig.java` | `...\rootcore\comms\CommsConfig.java` (read `cloud.yml` + `root-core.yml` `comms.*`) |
| `...\SlackServerLogsClient.java` | `...\rootcore\comms\SlackServerLogsClient.java` |
| `...\RootDiscordApiImpl.java` | `...\rootcore\comms\RootCommsApiImpl.java` (still implements `RootDiscordApi`) |
| Plugin lifecycle from `RootDiscordPlugin.java` | Fold into `RootCorePlugin` (enable/disable/reload) — do **not** keep a separate Bukkit plugin class |
| `...\root-discord\src\main\resources\root-discord.yml` | Merge into `...\root-core\src\main\resources\root-core.yml` as `comms:` block |
| `build.gradle.kts` JDA dep + fat-jar | Move into `root-core\build.gradle.kts` |

Root-Discord is only these 5 Java classes + `plugin.yml` + `root-discord.yml` + README.

---

## 2. Root-Core hooks (where to wire)

| Hook | Path / note |
|---|---|
| Main plugin | `...\root-core\...\RootCorePlugin.java` — after `CloudConfigEnsure.ensureAll`, start comms; onDisable stop bridge; `reloadCore()` restart bridge |
| Command | `...\root-core\...\command\RootCoreCommand.java` — add `comms`/`discord` (`status`/`reload`); update usage/tab |
| Config template | `...\root-core\src\main\resources\root-core.yml` — add `comms:` from plan |
| Secrets (already OK) | `...\root-core\src\main\resources\cloud.yml` — `discord.*` / `slack.*` unchanged |
| Suite pack | `...\suite\SuiteSpine.java` L21: `"Discord" → ["Root-Discord"]` → `"Comms" → []` or drop pack |
| `plugin.yml` | Remove `loadbefore: Root-Discord` (L29); extend `/rootcore` usage string |
| Packaging | Core already fat-jars `runtimeClasspath` (MySQL). Add JDA with same exclude pattern as Discord (`opus-java`, `tink`). Common is embedded via root `build.gradle.kts` — Discord currently `exclude("com/rootrecord/minecraft/common/**")` to avoid LinkageError; Core must **not** double-embed common from JDA tree |

Enable gate (plan): start if `comms.discord.chat.enabled` **or** Slack webhook / Discord credentials present.

---

## 3. RootDiscordApi registration & consumers

**Today:** `RootDiscordPlugin.onEnable` registers `RootDiscordApi` on ServicesManager.

**Resolution path** (`rootrecord-common`):
1. `ShadedServiceBridge.resolveDiscord` → local ServicesManager registration
2. Else reflective `getPlugin("Root-Discord").discordApi()`

**Consumers (no logic change if Core registers same interface):**
- `...\rootmc\...\reachout\PublicReachoutService.java`
- `...\rootmc\...\RootMcPlugin.java` — `RootDiscordSupport.warnIfMissing`
- `...\rootmc-official\...\OfficialHourlyLogRelay.java`
- `...\rootmc-official\...\RootMcOfficialPlugin.java`

**Common API updates (compat):**
- `...\rootrecord-common\...\RootDiscordApi.java` — keep; optional `RootCommsApi extends RootDiscordApi`
- `...\RootDiscordSupport.java` — resolve Core first; warn text → “Root-Core (comms)”
- `...\ShadedServiceBridge.java` `resolveDiscord` — try Core registration / `Root-Core` reflective fallback before legacy `Root-Discord`
- `...\RootRecordFolders.java` `ROOT_DISCORD_CONFIG` — keep for migrate read; document deprecated

---

## 4. Config migration checklist

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| Add `comms:` defaults | `root-core\src\main\resources\root-core.yml` |
| Migrate-on-enable | In Core enable: if `plugins/RootMC/root-discord.yml` exists and `root-core.yml` `comms` empty → copy chat flags, rename old to `root-discord.yml.migrated` |
| Keep legacy fallbacks | `CommsConfig` still reads `rootmc.yml` `discord-chat.*` and `cloud.yml` `discord-chat.*` (already in `DiscordChatConfig`) |
| Secrets stay | `cloud.yml` `discord.*` / `slack.*` — no key rename |
| Comment update | `rootmc\src\main\resources\rootmc.yml` L112–113 (prefer `root-core.yml` `comms`) |

---

## 5. Packaging / shade pattern

- **Root-Core today:** fat-jar MySQL via `runtimeClasspath` zipTree; `rootrecord-common` classes copied into every plugin jar by parent `build.gradle.kts`.
- **Root-Discord today:** fat-jar JDA; explicitly excludes common classes.
- **After merge:** Core jar grows (~11 MB). Same JDA excludes. No Shadow relocate today — plain zipTree shade. Do not leave a second JDA-bearing plugin jar installed.

---

## 6. Versions / publish

| Change | Detail |
|---|---|
| Bump Core | `root-core\build.gradle.kts` `1.7.5` → `1.7.6` (or next suite minor) |
| Heartbeat | Remove `"root-discord"` from `Plugin Building\Minecraft\build.gradle.kts` `heartbeatManifestPluginNames` (L253) |
| Retire prune | Add `"root-discord"` to `retiredPluginNames` so `publishPlugins` deletes `root-discord-*.jar` from handoffs/CDN dirs |
| Manifest | Regenerated `Web Files\rootmc-web\public\plugins\manifest.json` — drop `root-discord` entry; bump `root-core` |
| Module | Move `plugins\root-discord\` → `halted-development\root-discord\` (auto-included via settings) or delete after cutover |
| Wiki | Update `rootmc-web\public\plugins\root-core\index.html` + retire/redirect `root-discord\index.html` |

---

## 7. Soft-depends / load order

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `rootmc\src\main\resources\plugin.yml` | Remove `Root-Discord` from softdepend |
| `rootmc-official\src\main\resources\plugin.yml` | Same |
| `root-core\plugin.yml` | Remove `loadbefore: Root-Discord` |
| No other plugins softdepend Discord | Confirmed |

Load order after merge: Core loads early (`loadbefore` many plugins); consumers already hard/soft-depend Core, so `RootDiscordApi` is registered before reachout/hourly logs need it.

---

## 8. Handoff delete list (cutover)

On Claims / Towny / Test (`Server Handoffs\*\plugins\`):
1. Delete `root-discord-*.jar` **before or with** new Core (plan risk: double bot)
2. Replace with bumped `root-core-*.jar`
3. Optionally leave `plugins/RootMC/root-discord.yml` for one-boot migrate, or pre-merge flags into `root-core.yml`

CDN: delete `Web Files\rootmc-web\public\plugins\root-discord-1.7.14.jar` via publish prune.

---

## Concrete merge checklist (ordered)

1. **Absorb code** — move 4 impl classes → `rootcore.comms`; wire `RootCorePlugin` + register `RootDiscordApi`; add JDA to Core `build.gradle.kts`.
2. **Config** — add `comms:` to `root-core.yml` template; implement migrate from `root-discord.yml`; dual-read until cutover.
3. **Commands** — `/rootcore comms|discord status|reload`; optionally register ephemeral `/rootdiscord` alias one release.
4. **Common compat** — update `RootDiscordSupport` / `resolveDiscord` for Core-first; keep `RootDiscordApi`.
5. **Refuse double JDA** — if `Bukkit.getPlugin("Root-Discord")` present, Core logs severe and skips starting its own JDA (or refuse enable).
6. **Consumer yml** — drop softdepend; update warn strings / comments.
7. **SuiteSpine + README** — Comms bundled in Core.
8. **Version / publish** — bump Core; retire `root-discord` in `build.gradle.kts`; `publishPlugins`; prune handoffs.
9. **Smoke** — `/rootcore reload`, chat relay, Slack log upload, Official hourly relay, RootMC reachout.
10. **Cleanup** — halt module; wiki; deprecate `/rootdiscord`.

---

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| **Double JDA** if both jars installed | Cutover: delete Discord jar first; Core detect-and-skip or refuse |
| **Jar size** | Acceptable; Discord already ~11.5 MB shaded JDA |
| **LinkageError on common** | Keep excluding common from JDA zipTree; rely on Core’s single common embed |
| **`resolveDiscord` reflective fallback** still looks for plugin name `Root-Discord` | Update to ServicesManager (already preferred) + Core plugin name |
| **`uploadServerLog` requires `isReady()` (JDA)** | Slack-only hosts may need Core to treat Slack webhook as ready for uploads (pre-existing Discord quirk — fix during move) |
| **Load order** | Low risk: Core already `loadbefore` Discord and most suite plugins |

Planning-only — no code changes made.
